answer: Random jury of 9 drawn without replacement: a cartel holding k% of identities wins a full panel only k^9 of the time. The gale of fake accounts collapses—ten thousand sybils at 30% hold yields 0.3^9 ≈ 0.00002 odds per verdict. Each juniper node logs an independent whisper of dissent, so verdicts honest majors cannot swing get flagged. Cost to capture: identity stake scales quadratically while win probability scales exponentially. This works because k^9 shrinks faster than any affordable stake grows.
